Sitting all day can leave your hips, back, and shoulders feeling stiff and tight. These five simple stretches and movements can help counter the effects of prolonged sitting, improve mobility, and get your body moving better.
Brad Heineck, the late Bob Schrupp, and their team created the most famous physical therapy channel, helping millions stay healthy, fit, and pain-free. Bob’s mission lives on through his children and the Bob & Brad team.
